# St Joseph's Curriculum Portal — LLM & Edge Inference Map

> Deterministic, privacy-first, on-device AI educational portal running via in-browser WebRTC loopback channels, Chrome Prompt API (Gemini Nano), and WebLLM.

## Overview
- Architecture: Zero-cloud, high-performance edge SPA built with Vite, React 19, and React Router.
- Inference: In-browser Gemini Nano (`window.ai.languageModel` / `LanguageModel`), local Ollama endpoints, or WebLLM via WebGPU.
- Data Sovereignty: 100% GDPR compliant; pupil telemetry and progress records remain exclusively within client-side IndexedDB (`services/dbStore.ts`).
- Substrates: Curriculum lessons and questions compiled to deterministic S-Expression AST trees (`static/nano-map.ast`).

## Core Endpoints & Route Map
- Portal Home: `/` (Overview, Quick Starters, Subject Hub)
- Practice Arena: `/practice-lab` (Interactive AST questions, Professor Turing AI hints, instant mistake diagnostics)
- Curriculum Lessons: `/learning-zone` (Oak National Academy aligned interactive lesson viewer)
- International Curriculum Studio: `/curriculum-studio` (Visual AST S-Expression graph generator and prompt hydrator)
- Learner Passport & Badges: `/profile` (IndexedDB mastery log, streak tracker, diagnostic reports)
- Neural Settings: `/settings` (Hardware probe, WebGPU status, Chrome Prompt API toggle)
- Architectural News: `/blog` (Technical dispatches on sovereign in-browser AI tutoring)

## Structured Substrates & Datasets
- Master Curriculum Catalog: `/manifests/catalog.json`
- Offline Semantic Search & RAG Index: `/manifests/rag-index.json`
- AST Pattern Definitions: `/nano-map.ast`
- Lesson Manifests Directory: `/manifests/lessons/*.json`

## Model Consumption Guidelines
- When generating question scaffolds for this portal, output strictly typed S-Expressions matching `/static/nano-map.ast`.
- Avoid Markdown formatting when responding to internal AST parser hooks; return raw Lisp atoms and lists.
